## Jaipuria Jaipur MBA: Overview

Jaipuria Institute of Management, Jaipur offers a two-year full-time PGDM programme that is AIU-recognised as equivalent to an MBA. The Jaipur campus is part of the Jaipuria group, which operates campuses in Jaipur, Noida, Lucknow and Indore.

The programme combines classroom learning with case analysis, projects, industry interaction, internships and professional-development activities. Students can apply through the common Jaipuria admission process and indicate their preferred campus and programme.

Why consider Jaipuria Jaipur?

The main attraction is the combination of a recognised PGDM, a relatively moderate fee compared with many private B-schools, multiple management specialisations and an active recruiter ecosystem. Students should still compare campus-specific outcomes, fees and their own career target before accepting an offer.

## Jaipuria Jaipur MBA Admission 2026-27

Jaipuria's admission process uses a common application window across its campuses. Applicants submit their profile, pay the application processing fee and complete the application with academic, test and profile details.

| Stage | What students need to do |
| --- | --- |
| Register | Fill the common application and select preferred campus/programme. |
| Application fee | ₹1,000 non-refundable admission-process entrance fee. |
| Complete application | Submit aptitude-test, academic, extracurricular and work-experience details. |
| Interview | Shortlisted candidates are invited for case analysis and personal interview. |
| Offer | Selected candidates receive an offer and confirm admission through the required first-trimester payment. |

2026-28 cycle

The current Jaipuria admission material refers to CAT 2026/XAT 2027/CMAT/MAT/GMAT scores. Always check the current application window before applying because dates can change.

## Jaipuria Jaipur MBA Eligibility

Applicants must hold a bachelor's degree from a recognised Indian university with at least 50% marks or equivalent CGPA. Final-year graduation students can also apply subject to the institute's completion and document-submission conditions.

### Academic requirement

Minimum 50% in a recognised bachelor's degree or equivalent CGPA.

### Entrance test

Valid CAT 2026, XAT 2027, CMAT, MAT or GMAT score accepted for the selection process.

## Jaipuria Jaipur MBA Selection Criteria

The 2026-27 admission policy uses a 100-point selection framework. The aptitude-test score and personal interview together account for 70% of the score.

45%Aptitude test10%Case analysis25%Personal interview15%Academic performance

| Component | Weightage |
| --- | --- |
| CAT/XAT/CMAT/MAT/GMAT score | 45% |
| Case Analysis | 10% |
| Personal Interview | 25% |
| Academic performance: X, XII, degree/postgraduate | 15% |
| Work experience, sports & extracurricular activities | 3% |
| Diversity | 2% |

Student takeaway

Jaipuria does not select students on an entrance-test score alone. Academic record, case analysis, PI, profile and diversity all contribute to the final evaluation.

## Jaipuria Jaipur MBA Cutoff

Jaipuria's published admission process does not specify a single guaranteed CAT/XAT/CMAT/MAT/GMAT percentile as the final-admission cutoff. Instead, the institute evaluates the complete profile using its selection-weightage framework.

| What to check | Why it matters |
| --- | --- |
| Entrance score | Carries the largest single weightage at 45%. |
| Academics | 15% of the selection score. |
| Case analysis + PI | 35% combined, making interview preparation important. |
| Profile | Work experience, sports, extracurriculars and diversity add further points. |

The core PGDM is a general management programme with opportunities to build expertise around contemporary management functions. Students should confirm the exact elective/specialisation basket available for their batch.

## Jaipuria Jaipur MBA Scholarships

Jaipuria offers merit-based scholarships linked to national management aptitude-test performance. The published scholarship structure for the 2027-29 batch shows PGDM scholarships of ₹5 lakh for 90% and above, ₹3.5 lakh for 80% and above, ₹2.5 lakh for 70% and above and ₹1.5 lakh for 60% and above. The applicable scholarship for a student's batch should be checked in the current offer policy.

| Published test performance band | PGDM scholarship |
| --- | --- |
| 90% and above | ₹5,00,000 |
| 80% and above | ₹3,50,000 |
| 70% and above | ₹2,50,000 |
| 60% and above | ₹1,50,000 |

Jaipuria also lists sibling scholarship support and education-loan assistance through partner banks/NBFCs.

## Jaipuria Jaipur Campus & Student Life

The Jaipur campus offers hostel accommodation for boys and girls, classrooms, library and student-focused facilities. The institute's academic ecosystem includes industry interactions, workshops, case activities, clubs, competitions and professional-development initiatives.

## Is Jaipuria Jaipur MBA Worth Considering?

### Good fit if...

You want a private B-school in Jaipur, value a structured PGDM with MBA equivalence, need multiple accepted entrance tests and want a broad corporate-placement ecosystem.

### Compare carefully if...

You are deciding mainly on placement ROI. The latest published placement figures are combined across four campuses, so compare Jaipur-specific outcomes, your expected scholarship and total living cost before paying the fee.

CollegeDecoded verdict

Jaipuria Jaipur can be a practical option for students seeking a recognised MBA-equivalent PGDM in Jaipur. Its ₹14.75 lakh 2026-28 programme fee and current placement highlights make ROI worth evaluating alongside scholarships, hostel cost, career function and alternative B-schools.

## Jaipuria Jaipur MBA FAQs

### FAQ: Is Jaipuria Jaipur a good option for an MBA?
Jaipuria Jaipur can be a relevant option for students looking for a private management institute with a two-year full-time PGDM, MBA equivalence through AIU recognition, multiple management career areas and structured industry exposure. The programme combines classroom learning with case analysis, projects, internships and professional-development activities. However, whether it is a good choice depends on your target career, entrance-score profile, budget and the alternatives available at your percentile. Students should also remember that the latest placement figures published by Jaipuria are combined across Jaipur, Noida, Lucknow and Indore rather than being Jaipur-campus-only figures. Therefore, compare the fee, placement transparency, preferred specialization and location before making the final decision.

### FAQ: What is the eligibility for Jaipuria Jaipur PGDM/MBA?
Applicants must have a bachelor's degree from a recognised Indian university with at least 50% marks or an equivalent CGPA. Final-year students can also apply, subject to the institute's conditions for completing the degree and submitting the required proof within the specified timeline. For the current admission cycle, Jaipuria lists CAT, XAT, CMAT, MAT and GMAT as accepted aptitude tests. Meeting the academic eligibility requirement makes you eligible to apply, but it does not by itself guarantee selection because the institute evaluates the overall profile through its selection process.

### FAQ: Which entrance exams are accepted by Jaipuria Jaipur?
Jaipuria accepts valid scores from CAT, XAT, CMAT, MAT and GMAT for its PGDM admission process. Applicants use the common Jaipuria application to indicate their preferred campus and programme and provide their relevant test score details. The exact test year mentioned in the admission notification changes with the admission cycle, so students should use the test combinations stated for their intended batch rather than relying on an older admission page. A valid entrance score is an important part of the application because the aptitude-test component carries 45% weightage in the published selection framework.

### FAQ: What is the selection process for Jaipuria Jaipur?
Jaipuria's published selection framework evaluates more than just the entrance-test percentile. The aptitude-test score carries 45%, case analysis carries 10%, and the personal interview carries 25%. Academic performance across Class X, Class XII and degree/postgraduate qualifications contributes 15%, while work experience, sports and extracurricular activities contribute 3% and diversity contributes 2%. This means an applicant with a strong test score still needs to perform well in the case analysis and interview and maintain a credible academic and overall profile. Shortlisted candidates are invited for the institute's evaluation process before the final admission decision is made.

### FAQ: What is the fee for Jaipuria Jaipur PGDM?
The official fee structure for the 2026-28 batch lists the Jaipuria Jaipur PGDM programme fee at ₹14.75 lakh for the full two-year programme. It is divided into six instalments: ₹2.70 lakh, ₹2.40 lakh, ₹2.40 lakh, ₹2.65 lakh, ₹2.30 lakh and ₹2.30 lakh. In addition, a refundable ₹15,000 security deposit is payable with the first instalment, while applicable GST or other taxes may be extra. Hostel accommodation is charged separately; the published 2026-27 hostel fee is ₹2.10 lakh for AC single occupancy and ₹1.40 lakh for AC double occupancy, with mess charges and the hostel security deposit additional.

### FAQ: What is the placement scenario at Jaipuria Jaipur?
Jaipuria's latest published placement information reports a ₹24.11 LPA highest CTC, ₹14.70 LPA average CTC for the top 10% of students and ₹13.18 LPA for the top 20%, along with more than 1,100 students placed and 350+ participating companies in the latest published cycle. The most important point for Jaipur applicants is that these placement numbers are presented as combined figures for Jaipuria's Jaipur, Noida, Lucknow and Indore campuses. They therefore should not be read as the guaranteed average or highest package for Jaipur campus alone. Students should use the figures as an overall indicator of the institute's recruiter ecosystem and ask for campus-specific outcomes when comparing offers.

### FAQ: Does Jaipuria Jaipur offer scholarships?
Yes. Jaipuria offers merit-based scholarships and other financial-support options. The published scholarship structure includes entrance-test-linked awards, with the current fee/admission information showing scholarships that can go up to ₹5 lakh depending on the qualifying score band and programme. Jaipuria also lists a sibling scholarship and education-loan assistance through partner banks and NBFCs. Scholarship availability, amount, eligibility conditions and the applicable test-year rules can change by batch, so students should verify the scholarship terms attached to their specific admission offer rather than deducting the maximum advertised scholarship automatically from the programme fee.

### FAQ: Is hostel accommodation available at Jaipuria Jaipur?
Yes. Jaipuria Jaipur provides hostel accommodation options for students, with published 2026-27 rates of ₹2.10 lakh per year for AC single occupancy and ₹1.40 lakh per year for AC double occupancy. A separate refundable hostel security deposit is payable, and mess charges are additional. Hostel allotment is subject to availability and the institute's allocation process, so students who want campus accommodation should check the latest hostel notice and complete the required process on time. When calculating the actual MBA budget, students should therefore consider tuition, security deposits, hostel and mess costs together rather than looking only at the ₹14.75 lakh programme fee.
